L00922 REJECTED TEXT="Virtual-machine memory allocation: The host owns physical machine frames, but the guest chooses which guest pages are least useful. A host-only page eviction decision can harm the guest because the hypervisor lacks complete knowledge of its replacement policy. Ballooning transfers the reclamation decision to the guest by causing it to free its own pages. The design question is what happens if the host changes its request during balloon inflation, and what state the driver must bound or reset." Ballooning transfers the reclamation decision to the guest by causing it to free its own pages. The design question is what happens if the host changes its request during balloon inflation, and what state the driver must bound or reset." L01106 REJECTED TEXT="Virtual-machine memory allocation: The host owns physical machine frames, but the guest chooses which guest pages are least useful. A host-only page eviction decision can harm the guest because the hypervisor lacks complete knowledge of its replacement policy. Ballooning transfers the reclamation decision to the guest by causing it to free its own pages. The design question is what happens if the host changes its request during balloon inflation, and what state the driver must bound or reset." Deduplication compares page contents and safely replaces mappings with a shared read-only backing page, with copying required upon writes. The design question is how to update all mappings and reference counts while preserving permissions and handling concurrent writes, migration, and invalidation." L01152 REJECTED TEXT="Virtual-machine memory allocation: The host owns physical machine frames, but the guest chooses which guest pages are least useful. A host-only page eviction decision can harm the guest because the hypervisor lacks complete knowledge of its replacement policy. Ballooning transfers the reclamation decision to the guest by causing it to free its own pages. The design question is what happens if the host changes its request during balloon inflation, and what state the driver must bound or reset." L01261 REJECTED TEXT="Virtual-machine memory allocation: The host owns physical machine frames, but the guest chooses which guest pages are least useful. A host-only page eviction decision can harm the guest because the hypervisor lacks complete knowledge of its replacement policy. Ballooning transfers the reclamation decision to the guest by causing it to free its own pages. The design question is what happens if the host changes its request during balloon inflation, and what state the driver must bound or reset." L01378 REJECTED TEXT="Virtual-machine memory allocation: The host owns physical machine frames, but the guest chooses which guest pages are least useful. A host-only page eviction decision can harm the guest because the hypervisor lacks complete knowledge of its replacement policy. Ballooning transfers the reclamation decision to the guest by causing it to free its own pages. The design question is what happens if the host changes its request during balloon inflation, and what state the driver must bound or reset." L00567 REJECTED TEXT="Virtual-machine memory allocation: The host owns physical machine frames, but the guest chooses which guest pages are least useful. A host-only page eviction decision can harm the guest because the hypervisor lacks complete knowledge of its replacement policy. Ballooning transfers the reclamation decision to the guest by causing it to free its own pages. The design question is what happens if the host changes its request during balloon inflation, and what state the driver must bound or reset."
